comment: Real match captures. Timing selects a moment, not a promised game phase. The output records the observed round, role, map, weapon, and camera. Inspect the images for quality.

states.name: boot_menu
states.note: Retro menu, keyboard focus, legibility, and unclipped options.

states.name: spectator_eyes
states.note: Default spectator view follows the fighter's eyes and weapon.

states.name: arena_overview
states.note: Server geometry, traversable lanes, steps, cover, and lighting.

states.name: combat_follow
states.note: Optional chase view and readable fighter silhouettes.

states.name: hud_first_person
states.note: Actual human join, saved callsign, gun silhouette, and aim visibility.

states.name: rail_viewmodel
states.note: Server-confirmed rail selection and its distinct reticle.

states.name: shot_effects
states.note: Twelve frames starting at an acknowledged shot. Inspect flash registration, recoil, and recovery.

states.name: scatter_viewmodel
states.note: Server-confirmed scatter selection and reticle.

states.name: vertical_aim_up
states.note: Upward aim is confirmed in the authoritative snapshot before capture.

states.name: vertical_aim_down
states.note: Downward aim follows the same action, camera, and server pitch contract.

states.name: rail_impact
states.note: Single acknowledged local rail shot into the floor, sampled through expiry. Inspect the full-size shot and timed strip for position, sparks, trace, and decay.

states.name: return_to_spectator
states.note: Leave the match and follow a remaining fighter without stale geometry or hidden bodies.

states.name: spectator_chase
states.note: Return to chase after eye view. The watched body must be visible again.

states.name: profile_menu
states.note: Callsign, reticle colour, bob, save, and cancel. This capture does not overwrite the user's settings.

states.name: settings_menu
states.note: Settings share the pixel menu theme and remain fully legible.

states.name: settings_display
states.note: Explicit vertical FOV, window mode, frame cap, and VSync.

states.name: settings_audio
states.note: Separate master, radio, and effects controls with Save and Cancel.

states.name: multiplayer_menu
states.note: Address entry and focus without clipping or unsupported hosting claims.

states.name: single_player_menu
states.note: Recall Notice starts a local mission; arcade practice requires an existing server.

states.name: campaign_difficulty
states.note: Three explicit tiers with honest pressure descriptions and keyboard focus.

states.name: match_menu
states.note: Pixel match overlay keeps the live server visible and does not pretend to pause it.

states.name: match_settings
states.note: The same settings panel over a live match, with camera input blocked.

states.name: service_record
states.note: Persisted participant observations from this tour, with incomplete sessions labelled and exact attack denominators.
